    1:2 serial dilution — 12 columns, 8 channels (rows A-H), 50 µL tips.

    Hardware configuration is ignored per requirements; a dilution plate with
    50 µL tips is assumed. Only the first 12 columns (rows A-H) are used.
    """

    # --- Resource setup ---
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    dilution_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")  # dilution plate (cols 1-12, rows A-H)
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")         # neat sample input
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")             # diluent reservoir (12 channels)

    # --- Protocol parameters ---
    TRANSFER_VOL = 40        # µL per transfer (80% of 50 µL tip capacity, safe headroom)
    N_COLUMNS = 12           # serial dilution spans columns 1 -> 12
    MIX_CYCLES = 3           # mix cycles to homogenize before each serial transfer
    N_CHANNELS = 8           # channels addressed per column (rows A-H)

    # Volume sanity check against tip capacity
    if TRANSFER_VOL > 50:
        raise ValueError("Transfer volume exceeds 50 µL tip capacity")

    # Volume list matched to the 8 channels used per column operation
    col_vols = [TRANSFER_VOL] * N_CHANNELS

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Pick up 8 tips (column 1 of the tip rack) for the diluent fill
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1:H1"])
    for col in range(2, N_COLUMNS + 1):
        # Aspirate diluent from one trough channel per plate column
        await lh.aspirate(trough[f"A{col}"], vols=col_vols)
        # Dispense into column 'col' of the dilution plate (rows A-H)
        await lh.dispense(dilution_plate[f"A{col}:H{col}"], vols=col_vols)
